expectations.text: Computes H(Y|X) = H(Y) - I(X;Y) = log2(10) - 1.5 ~= 1.822 bits.
Applies Fano's inequality H(Y|X) <= H(Pe) + Pe*log2(K-1) to bound the error rate.
Gives a numeric floor: weak-form ~0.247 and/or the tight solution ~0.298 (accept ~0.25-0.30), i.e. at least ~25-30% error is unavoidable.
expectations.evidence: Loose bound: Pe ≥ (1.822-1)/log₂(9) ≈ 0.259; tight: Pe ≈ 0.296. Both within acceptance range.

expectations.text: Interprets it as a model-independent floor (a result below it implies leakage / broken eval), ideally noting a biased-low H(Y|X) loosens the bound.
expectations.evidence: States floor is model-independent; implies leakage if beaten. Notes MI resolves only 45% of label entropy.

eval_feedback.overall: Both pass all assertions. Fano's inequality is well-known to the base model.
